question: Give one concrete implementation-ready design direction for this existing React fintech wallet. Owner says ugly and wants visceral collateral/credit bars with Stripe-quality hierarchy. Current screenshot: dark bank theme; hero $699.85; available pay $699.85; giant faucet; 3 large Pay Receive Swap buttons then 6 equally large secondary actions then 3 help accordions then buried 6px balance bar ($499.85 collateral/$200 unsecured). Redesign Home, not protocol. Financial truths: unused credit is not wealth, only collateral secures recovery. Keep exact deriveDelta semantics and global dollars-per-pixel comparability; no guessed protection percentages or yield. Actual wallet values and settings must survive. Need desktop + narrow mobile, keyboard/touch accessibility. Return <=650 words: precise first-viewport structure, how to visibly distinguish backing vs credit capacity, actionable component/CSS changes, 3 important edge cases. Reuse existing bars; reduce code and visual clutter. No research, tools or execution. Supplied source is immutable; cite relevant paths. This is one bounded design consultation, not a security audit or release certification.
